scenes.tts: What can three families show that no screen in a dish could?
scenes.visual: Title card: Three Families, One Gene. Three pedigree symbols beside a cell-culture dish with a question mark.
scenes.narration: What can three families show that no screen in a dish could?

scenes.tts: Pain signals start in sensory neurons called nociceptors. Their spikes need voltage-gated sodium channels.
scenes.visual: A nociceptor from skin to spinal cord, with sodium channels drawn along it and a spike running inward.
scenes.narration: Pain signals start in sensory neurons called nociceptors. Their spikes need voltage-gated sodium channels.

scenes.tts: The channel in this story was not nominated by a screen in a dish. It was found in families.
scenes.visual: A culture dish fades out; three pedigrees fade in beside it.
scenes.narration: The channel in this story was not nominated by a screen in a dish. It was found in families.

scenes.tts: Three consanguineous families in northern Pakistan had members who had never experienced pain.
scenes.visual: A map marker over northern Pakistan opens into three pedigrees, affected members filled in.
scenes.narration: Three consanguineous families in northern Pakistan had members who had never experienced pain.

scenes.tts: Six affected children were examined clinically. They were aged four to fourteen.
scenes.caption: Six affected children were examined clinically. They were aged 4 to 14.
scenes.visual: Six child figures highlighted in the pedigrees. On screen: 6 affected children, aged 4 to 14.
scenes.narration: Six affected children were examined clinically. They were aged 4 to 14.

scenes.tts: The condition was recessive. Affected children carried two broken copies of one gene.
scenes.visual: One pedigree zooms in: two carrier parents, one affected child, allele pairs drawn beneath each symbol.
scenes.narration: The condition was recessive. Affected children carried two broken copies of one gene.

scenes.tts: Mapping and sequencing found three different homozygous nonsense mutations in S C N nine A.
scenes.caption: Mapping and sequencing found three different homozygous nonsense mutations in SCN9A.
scenes.visual: A chromosome ideogram narrows to a gene cartoon. Three stop-codon flags at three positions. Label: SCN9A.
scenes.narration: Mapping and sequencing found three different homozygous nonsense mutations in SCN9A.

scenes.tts: That gene encodes N A V one point seven, a sodium channel concentrated in pain-sensing neurons.
scenes.caption: That gene encodes Nav1.7, a sodium channel concentrated in pain-sensing neurons.
scenes.visual: The gene cartoon becomes a channel in a membrane, drawn in a nociceptor terminal in skin. Label: Nav1.7.
scenes.narration: That gene encodes Nav1.7, a sodium channel concentrated in pain-sensing neurons.

scenes.tts: A gene now travels with the phenotype. What measurement would you insist on next?
scenes.visual: The three pedigrees sit beside an empty recording rig. On screen: what would you measure?
scenes.narration: A gene now travels with the phenotype. What measurement would you insist on next?

scenes.tts: Linkage says the variant travels with the phenotype. It cannot say the protein stopped working.
scenes.visual: A pedigree with a tick beside it, and a channel with a question mark beside that.
scenes.narration: Linkage says the variant travels with the phenotype. It cannot say the protein stopped working.

scenes.tts: A nonsense allele is not by itself proof of absent functional current. Expressing mutant c D N A tests the construct's functional output, without reproducing native transcript processing or measuring protein abundance in a patient's neurons.
scenes.visual: A stop codon flagged in the gene, with a shrug icon over the protein cartoon. Beside it: mutant cDNA in a cell line, labelled heterologous cDNA assay; native transcript processing and protein abundance not measured.
scenes.narration: A nonsense allele is not by itself proof of absent functional current. Expressing mutant cDNA tests the construct's functional output, without reproducing native transcript processing or measuring protein abundance in a patient's neurons.
scenes.caption: A nonsense allele is not by itself proof of absent functional current. Expressing mutant cDNA tests the construct's functional output, without reproducing native transcript processing or measuring protein abundance in a patient's neurons.

scenes.tts: So put the mutant channel in cultured cells and look for current.
scenes.visual: A patch pipette seals onto a cultured cell expressing the channel with accessory subunits. Label: HEK293 cells, wild type and mutant.
scenes.narration: So put the mutant channel in cultured cells and look for current.

scenes.tts: The mutant constructs gave no current above the recording background. That is no measurable conduction, not a proven absence of protein.
scenes.visual: Two current traces side by side: a large inward current for wild type, and for the mutant a trace flat at the recording background, with the detection limit drawn as a dashed band.
scenes.narration: The mutant constructs gave no current above the recording background. That is no measurable conduction, not a proven absence of protein.

scenes.tts: So the genetics and the biophysics pointed the same way.
scenes.visual: The pedigree and the flat trace joined by an arrow to one label: loss of function.
scenes.narration: So the genetics and the biophysics pointed the same way.

scenes.tts: Lose this one channel, and the painful world goes quiet while touch continues.
scenes.visual: A hand on a hot surface with no withdrawal, beside the same hand feeling a brush, which still registers.
scenes.narration: Lose this one channel, and the painful world goes quiet while touch continues.

scenes.tts: The children could still tell hot food from cold, though temperature sensation was not rigorously assessed.
scenes.visual: Two cups, one steaming and one iced, with a caution tag: not rigorously assessed.
scenes.narration: The children could still tell hot food from cold, though temperature sensation was not rigorously assessed.

scenes.tts: The loss is not confined to pain. People with the same loss of function also cannot smell.
scenes.visual: A nose icon crossed out beside the pain icon. Label: anosmia.
scenes.narration: The loss is not confined to pain. People with the same loss of function also cannot smell.

scenes.tts: That result turned the channel into a major target for analgesic drug development.
scenes.visual: A drug-pipeline arrow from the channel cartoon toward a pill, with a growing stack of programme labels.
scenes.narration: That result turned the channel into a major target for analgesic drug development.

scenes.tts: It also set a standard. A human pain gene should arrive with a channel measurement attached.
scenes.visual: A rubber stamp lands on a file: gene plus channel measurement.
scenes.narration: It also set a standard. A human pain gene should arrive with a channel measurement attached.

scenes.tts: Human genetics supplied both the gene and the direction of its effect.
scenes.visual: An arrow from the pedigrees to the gene, and a second arrow labelled loss of function.
scenes.narration: Human genetics supplied both the gene and the direction of its effect.

scenes.tts: Here is the puzzle this lesson answers. The blocker that reached patients blocks a different channel.
scenes.visual: Two channels side by side: Nav1.7 flagged by genetics, Nav1.8 flagged by the 2025 drug, with a question mark between.
scenes.narration: Here is the puzzle this lesson answers. The blocker that reached patients blocks a different channel.

scenes.tts: Hold that gap in mind. Genetics nominated one channel, and the drug that worked blocks another.
scenes.visual: The two channels drawn on either side of a widening gap, with the lesson title between them.
scenes.narration: Hold that gap in mind. Genetics nominated one channel, and the drug that worked blocks another.

scenes.tts: Human genetics can nominate a channel. Only a recording can say whether the channel conducts.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: genetics nominates; the rig measures the current.
scenes.narration: Human genetics can nominate a channel. Only a recording can say whether the channel conducts.
